component	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
level	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
namespace	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
pod	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
node	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
source_file	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
msg	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	
kv	VARIANT	YES	NULL	
line	VARCHAR	YES	NULL	STORED COMPUTED COLUMN `concat_ws(' ', msg, nullif(json_path_query_array(object_delete(kv, 'container', 'service', 'format'), '$.*')::STRING, '[]'))`
raw	VARCHAR	YES	NULL
lsprobe|v1|section|create|logs.k8s_logs
k8s_logs	"CREATE TABLE k8s_logs (
  ts TIMESTAMP NULL,
  component VARCHAR NULL,
  level VARCHAR NULL,
  namespace VARCHAR NULL,
  pod VARCHAR NULL,
  node VARCHAR NULL,
  source_file VARCHAR NULL,
  msg VARCHAR NULL,
  kv VARIANT NULL,
  line VARCHAR NULL AS (concat_ws(' ', msg, nullif(json_path_query_array(object_delete(kv, 'container', 'service', 'format'), '$.*')::STRING, '[]'))) STORED,
  raw VARCHAR NULL,
  SYNC INVERTED INDEX idx_msg (source_file, msg, kv, line) filters = 'english_stop,english_stemmer', tokenizer = 'english',
  SYNC NGRAM INDEX idx_msg_ng (msg, line)
) ENGINE=FUSE CLUSTER BY (to_date(ts), component)"
